design: Creek orchid (Cymbidium-like): fan clump of 18 keeled strap leaves arching in crossing S curves, papery sheaths and pseudobulbs, three scapes with bracts and 5-7 nodding jade blossoms (cupped sepals, hooded petals, spotted recurved lip, the top ones buds) in the lee of a mossy stone. Post: scapes cut to stubs, outer leaves sickle-cut, young leaves kept, two new shoots, cut leaves / scape / blossoms on the soil.
material_direction: Glossy deep jade-green leaves (rough 0.32) with fine parallel veins, pale keel, yellow-green sheath base and a few straw-dry tips; blossoms pale jade with darker veins, ivory lip with red-violet spots, soft inner glow; papery straw sheaths.
front_axis: -Y (Blender); GLB exported +Y up, so the front faces +Z in glTF space
not_reproduced_in_game_material: crystal transmission (crystals are opaque with baked colour and emission)
iron metallic (baked as dark iron-grey dielectric: base colour mixed toward 0.055 grey by the metallic amount)
